_comment: G5 end-to-end live test (PLAN.md §5/§7 G1-G5) — provisioned demo3.steg.eth hands-off on mainnet to validate that a freshly provisioned agent is BOTH gate-authorizable (G2) and actable-as (G3+G4). First provision to carry the G2 capability+revocation records and the G4 dynamic-gate fix.
name: demo3.steg.eth
provisionedVia: POST /provision (option B, hot-key-signed; 1 operator Ledger sig for the mint)

tx._note: mint = operator Ledger (setSubnodeRecord, owner=hot key, block 25367082). fundHotKey = 0.001 ETH from the agent wallet 0x0943 via mm TEE (G5 setup). bind txHash surfaced by /provision (AgentBound decode). The fund-wallet, forward-records (setAddr+auth.credential+auth.capability+auth.revocation+trust-models = the G2 5-record multicall), ENSIP-26 records, agentURI, ENSIP-25, reverse (TEE), and transfer-to-operator txs were broadcast by /provision (hot key / TEE) and not surfaced in the SSE stream — all verified from current on-chain state below.

auth._comment: G2 — written by rebind-server-wallet.ts inside /provision's records step. Verified via direct PublicResolver.text() calls.

g5_gate._comment: G2+G4 ALLOW path proven AS demo3 through the production gate path (brain/app/gate.py → demo-mm.ts → local worker /evaluate).
g5_gate.allow: gate.py evaluate_action() → {allowed:true, reason:OK}; gate_or_refusal() → None. Name auto-derived demo3.steg.eth from the active wallet 0x1f3e reverse ENS; TEE-signed; signer matched demo3's published auth.credential signer.
g5_gate.deny: revoke→deny→un-revoke MECHANISM accepted as proven on agent.steg.eth (§5 A2, un-revoke tx 0x9d23c64a). The gate code path is name-agnostic; only the derived name differs, and derivation-as-demo3 is proven by the allow path.
g5_gate.g3: mm left selected on the new wallet 0x1f3e after provision (provisioned_ok flag) — reads + gate act as demo3.
g5_gate.g4_bug_fixed: Bun auto-loads the repo-root .env which pinned STEG_DEMO_NAME=agent.steg.eth, so the gate would always evaluate agent.steg.eth regardless of the active wallet. Fixed: gate.py sets STEG_DEMO_NAME="" explicitly (process env beats bun's .env); repo .env pin commented.

status: COMPLETE — demo3 provisioned + gate-authorizable + actable-as. G2+G3+G4 converge live.
note: demo3 is the third demo agent (after demo, demo2). Net hot-key gas burn ~tiny at ~0.25 gwei. Hot key 0xe53A funded 0.001 ETH from the agent wallet via mm TEE.
